propositions: Bedrock LLM operations fail with 'no AWS region could be resolved' when only AWS_REGION environment variable is set, because botocore does not consult AWS_REGION and rebar does not explicitly handle it
Resolution order must be: REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION (config) > AWS_DEFAULT_REGION (env) > AWS_REGION (env) > active boto3 profile fallback
Resolved bedrock region and its source must be recorded in provider provenance as region and region_source fields when rebar's chain resolves, and absent when only profile fallback applies
Error messages and documentation must clearly name the full region resolution chain and remove outdated guidance that AWS_REGION does not work
Passing region_name explicitly to boto3.session.Session bypasses botocore's AWS_REGION quirk and makes region handling deterministic within rebar's layer
